changelog:
CSM 1.0.882

Performance

• CSM's theme pass over the screens it owns is much cheaper. It used to walk the
  whole view tree thirteen times per pass - once for every view type it handles.
  It now takes a single snapshot and works from that: on a realistic 107-view
  home/result/player screen the number of tree walks drops from 15 to 1 and the
  visited nodes from 1605 to 214, which is 2 visits per view instead of 15.
• Nothing about the result changed: the same colours are applied, the same number
  of palette lookups happen, and turning CSM off still restores the host look
  exactly.

Honest notes

• The notification feed is still fetched on every start. That is deliberate: a
  cached feed would keep showing a removed announcement after it was corrected.
• The episode-total and watched-count lookups still use separate caches, so a
  series whose total was already learned is loaded once more when its watched
  count is asked for. Sharing that cache would couple two independently
  switchable features, so it stays as it is for now - the work is bounded to two
  lookups at a time with a ten-minute cache.

Providers in this repository

• FreeTv was removed. It only served public-broadcaster streams.
• IptvOrg now excludes public-broadcaster channels on purpose: ARD, ZDF, 3sat,
  arte, KiKA, phoenix, the ARD regional channels, Deutschlandfunk, Deutsche Welle,
  ORF and SRF are filtered out, private and commercial channels stay. That drops
  48 of 289 channels from the country list and 52 of 327 from the language list.
• BurningSeries and Xcine now expose their settings entry. Both read a debug
  option that was previously unreachable because the plugin never registered a
  settings sheet.
• New: AnimeStream (anime-stream.to) as a catalogue provider - its playback sits
  behind a Cloudflare Turnstile check that a plugin cannot solve, which the
  provider states plainly - and Doku-Streams (doku-streams.com), a German
  documentary portal whose films really play through their embedded YouTube
  player.
